items.title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
items.title_zh: SAVIOR：用于 OCR 表示的视觉语言模型的样本高效适应
items.description: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows. These patterns include vertical or rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts. While underrepresented in public datasets, they constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases. We introduce SAVIOR, a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets such high-impact failure scenarios to adapt vision-language models for robust financial OCR. We further propose PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity by comparing pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves a word recall of 0.93. When the resulting layout-aware OCR output is used as context for document question answering, it attains an F1 score of 0.89, outperforming both open- and closed-source models such as GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR.
items.description_zh: 光学字符识别 (OCR) 管道和视觉语言模型在标准 OCR 和文档理解基准上表现出很高的准确性，但它们在财务工作流程中操作关键的文档模式上系统性地表现不佳。这些模式包括垂直或旋转文本、嵌入徽标的供应商名称、精美印刷的监管条款、降级扫描和复杂的多列布局。虽然它们在公共数据集中的代表性不足，但它们构成了现实世界失败案例的很大一部分。我们推出了 SAVIOR，一种样本高效的数据管理方法，针对此类高影响力的故障场景，以适应视觉语言模型以实现强大的金融 OCR。我们进一步提出 PaIRS，一种结构感知评估指标，通过比较标记之间的成对空间关系来衡量布局保真度。使用 SAVIOR-Train 微调 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 可实现 0.93 的单词召回率。当生成的布局感知 OCR 输出用作文档问答的上下文时，它的 F1 分数为 0.89，优于 GPT-4o、Mistral-OCR、PaddleOCR-VL 和 DeepSeek-OCR 等开源和闭源模型。
items.authors: Akshata A Bhat, Sharath Naganna, Saiful Haq, Prashant Khatri, Krishna Chaitanya Reddy Tamataam, Neha Arun, Niyati Chhaya, Pushpak Bhattacharyya

items.title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
items.title_zh: GameAnything：从任何灵感到可玩的游戏世界
items.description: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.
items.description_zh: 人工智能驱动的游戏开发有潜力将不同的人类灵感转化为互动体验。然而，现有的系统和基准主要关注明确的开发规范，对适应多模式参考和评估实际游戏体验的支持有限。我们推出 GameAnything，这是一个开源代理平台，可通过迭代开发将多模式灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。 GameAnything 将编码代理与独立的游戏测试评论家、持久的开发状态和可重用的经验记忆集成在一起，以支持持续改进。我们进一步介绍了 GameAnything-Bench，这是一个涵盖不同参考模式、游戏创建目标和游戏环境的基准，并通过探索性游戏测试来评估功能正确性和游戏质量。对九种编码代理配置的评估表明，当前的代理可以适应参考内容，但仍然难以实现可玩的交互和精确的修改。此外，多模态参考提高了内容保真度，而迭代细化在各个代理之间产生了实质性但不同的改进。这些发现凸显了灵感驱动的游戏开发的潜力和仍然存在的挑战。
items.authors: Wenyi Wu, Siqi Liu, Yuru Feng, Zixuan Song, Aayush Salvi, Sibo Zhu, Kun Zhou, Biwei Huang

items.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 将 VLM 训练为机器人操作基础模型的一瞥
items.description: Recently, GPT-6 Astra demonstrates strong generalization in robot control, yet limited disclosure of its training leaves open how such capabilities can be reproduced. We introduce nanoAstra, an approach to training vision-language models (VLMs) for generalizable manipulation that combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning (CP-SFT). nanoAstra represents robot behavior as semantic steps composed of reusable, parameterized action primitives, guided by explicit progress descriptions. Meanwhile, CP-SFT uses an explicit robot-specific system prompt to constrain manipulation outputs to a structured action space, aiming to focus adaptation on robot-specific contexts and promote specialization while minimizing interference with broader pretrained capabilities. With this formulation, we train nanoAstra on more than 5,000 hours of robot data together with general VQA data. On RoboTwin 2.0's randomized benchmark, nanoAstra-9B achieves a 17.8% zero-shot success rate, substantially outperforming advanced VLA and WAM baselines as well as similarly sized VLMs. With inference faster than the corresponding motion execution on a single H20 GPU, our model supports action-chunk-like streaming execution that overlaps inference with motion, reducing the robot's idle time from 35.0% to 6.9%.
items.description_zh: 最近，GPT-6 Astra 在机器人控制方面展示了强大的泛化能力，但对其训练的有限披露却让如何重现这种能力留下了疑问。我们介绍了 nanoAstra，一种训练视觉语言模型 (VLM) 进行泛化操作的方法，它将语义动作建模与能力保留监督微调 (CP-SFT) 结合起来。 nanoAstra 将机器人行为表示为由可重用的参数化动作原语组成的语义步骤，并由明确的进度描述引导。同时，CP-SFT 使用明确的机器人特定系统提示将操作输出限制到结构化动作空间，旨在将适应机器人特定环境并促进专业化，同时最大限度地减少对更广泛的预训练功能的干扰。通过这个公式，我们使用超过 5,000 小时的机器人数据以及一般 VQA 数据来训练 nanoAstra。在 RoboTwin 2.0 的随机基准测试中，nanoAstra-9B 实现了 17.8% 的零射击成功率，大大优于先进的 VLA 和 WAM 基线以及类似大小的 VLM。我们的模型在单个 H20 GPU 上的推理速度比相应的运动执行速度更快，因此支持类似动作块的流执行，将推理与运动重叠，将机器人的空闲时间从 35.0% 减少到 6.9%。
items.authors: Meng-Hao Guo, Yi Zhang, Zhe-Han Mo, Han-Zheng Wang, Jia-Jun Wang, Xin-Sheng Chen, Jiaxi Song, Yi-Xuan Deng, Jia-Ning Li, Xuanyu Chu, Hengrui Zhang, Huan-ang Gao, Yongming Rao, Shi-Min Hu

items.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
items.title_zh: AutoPILOT：用于实时游戏的视觉代理线束
items.description: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.
items.description_zh: 多模式基础模型在游戏等待时可以很好地玩视频游戏，但当游戏继续运行时通常会失败。我们发现，这种差距很大程度上在于线束，它决定模型看到什么、记住什么，以及随着时间的推移，它的输出如何变成行动。 VISTA 等现有工具改进了前两个，但将每个模型调用最多转换为一个操作，因此代理仅按照其模型认为的频率进行操作。我们引入了 AutoPILOT，它改变了第三个：在每个模型调用中，模型可以发送一个原始动作，启动一个开环宏，或者编写一个闭环控制器，该控制器可以从屏幕上继续播放，而无需进一步的模型调用，直到它交回控制权。为了评估实时游戏中的代理，我们构建了 AFK-Bench，这是 120 种不同的浏览器游戏，根据它们对不作为的响应方式进行分组，并且可以实时玩或时钟暂停。在相同预算下，使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 时，AutoPILOT 的实时成功率达到 68.6%，而 VISTA 为 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上，它保持了 80.0% 的实时成功率，而 VISTA 则从 84.1% 下降到 42.9%。它的收益在各个模型中都保持不变，并且它以 API 成本的五分之一达到了 VISTA 的最终成功率。我们的结果表明，随着时间的���移，线束如何将模型输出转化为行动是智能体设计的一个核心但尚未得到充分探索的部分，我们希望 AutoPILOT 和 AFK-Bench 能够成为智能体在不等待的世界中的基础。
items.authors: Mark Zhao, Pengcheng Wang, Rui Yang, Jiarui Yao, Xirui Jiang, Yuxi Chen, Bingxuan Li, Hanyang Chen, Ke Yang, Manling Li, Tong Zhang, Huan Zhang

items.title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
items.title_zh: Self-WSP：语言模型可以通过权重空间编程自我改进吗？
items.description: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP. Specifically, Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes an edit, and then continues with the edited weights as both problem solver and editor. We find many cases of genuine self-improvement. Self-edits can raise GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 accuracy from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes by changing only 16 parameters, and in some cases repeated self-editing keeps improving the model. A closer look, however, reveals that these gains lack interpretability. The model shows little understanding of the edits it makes, and WSP driven by random search sometimes performs comparably. Self-WSP thus holds promise as a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), but realizing this promise requires further exploration.
items.description_zh: 前沿语言模型现在可以像代码一样读取和编辑神经网络的权重，从而改进小型模型，这种方法称为权重空间编程（WSP）。我们进一步探索将 WSP 应用于语言模型本身，我们称之为 Self-WSP。具体来说，Qwen3.5-0.8B 读取自己的权重，提出编辑建议，然后继续作为问题解决者和编辑者编辑权重。我们发现很多真正自我提升的案例。自编辑可以将 GSM8K 准确率从 11.8% 提高到 62.2%，将 MATH500 准确率从 7.0% 提高到 32.2%，有时只需更改 16 个参数，在某些情况下，重复自编辑可以不断改进模型。然而，仔细观察就会发现，这些成果缺乏可解释性。该模型对其所做的编辑了解甚少，而随机搜索驱动的 WSP 有时表现相当。因此，自我 WSP 有望成为递归自我改进 (RSI) 的道路，但实现这一承诺还需要进一步探索。
items.authors: Guoming Ling, Shanshan Zhong, Kaixuan Zhang, Zhongzhan Huang

items.title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
items.title_zh: WeightCode：通过权重空间编程将新功能安装到神经网络中
items.description: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. WeightCode, a WSP framework, uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new computations into trained neural networks using task knowledge and their existing weights, without gradient-based training. Once installed, the new capabilities run independently of the language model. Given a grammar or eight demonstrations, weight programs enable previously unseen command compositions (0% to 99.8% exact match) and a new pickup action (0% to 98.4% success), while preserving the original command and navigation capabilities. On ImageNet, four weight programs achieve net gains of 8.84-17.62 points while preserving clean accuracy, outperforming the best of eight fine-tuning methods under matched examples, checks, and retention constraints. In a Vision Transformer, causal interventions show that installed noise-correction gates drive robustness gains, while their selective activation preserves clean accuracy. Rerun on five independently trained Vision Transformers without further language model calls, ten weight programs retain 83-110% of their source-network gains on average, whereas copying their fixed weight edits yields negligible gains. Six programs written for an already edited network add 5.23-14.50 points of contrast robustness while retaining the previously installed noise gain. Together, these results establish WSP as a new route to acquiring and accumulating capabilities in trained neural networks through reusable weight programs.
items.description_zh: 神经网络在其权重中编码学习能力，但通过明确的任务知识扩展这些能力仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们展示了权重空间编程（WSP），其中可执行程序直接读取、构造或修改网络的权重，可以在经过训练的神经网络中安装新功能。 WeightCode 是一个 WSP 框架，它使用冻结的语言模型来编写可执行的权重程序，这些程序使用任务知识及其现有权重将新的计算安装到经过训练的神经网络中，而无需基于梯度的训练。安装后，新功能将独立于语言模型运行。给定语法或八次演示，权重程序可以实现以前未见过的命令组合（0％至99.8％的精确匹配）和新的拾取动作（0％至98.4％的成功），同时保留原始的命令和导航功能。在 ImageNet 上，四种权重程序实现了 8.84-17.62 分的净增益，同时保持了干净的准确性，在匹配示例、检查和保留约束下优于八种微调方法中的最佳方法。在视觉变压器中，因果干预表明安装的噪声校正门可以提高鲁棒性，而它们的选择性激活可以保持干净的准确性。在五个独立训练的 Vision Transformer 上重新运行，无需进一步的语言模型调用，十个权重程序平均保留其源网络增益的 83-110%，而复制其固定权重编辑产生的增益可以忽略不计。为已编辑的网络编写的六个程序增加了 5.23-14.50 点的对比度鲁棒性，同时保留了先前安装的噪声增益。总之，这些结果使 WSP 成为通过可重复使用的权重程序在经过训练的神经网络中获取和积累能力的新途径。
items.authors: Bo Li, Taoyong Cui, Bob Zhang, Mengran Li, Chengyang Zhang, Yang Zhang, Pheng Ann Heng, Wanli Ouyang, Zhenfei Yin, Yingcheng Wu, Ling Yang

items.title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
items.title_zh: Plan4D：生成式可规划 4D 世界
items.description: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project
items.description_zh: 大多数用于未来预测的世界模型都会优先考虑生成视频的审美质量，但由于缺乏明确的 4D 建模，随着时间的推移，仅提供较弱的物理基础和有限的几何一致性。在本文中，我们介绍了 plan4d，它可能是构建生成式可规划 4D 世界模型的下一个里程碑，该模型可以预测未来的 RGB 视频和密集的 4D 几何形状，包括深度、摄像机、点云以及来自观察到的场景上下文和文本指定动作的场景流。由于具有配对动作和密集 4D 注释的训练数据本质上是稀缺的，因此 plan4d 利用了基础视频生成器和 3D 重建器的互补先验。具体来说，我们提出了一种模型拼接架构，将 Depth Anything 3 与 LongCat-Video 结合起来，并使用辅助 DPT 头对其进行增强，以进行场景流预测。由此产生的模型使我们能够在动态 3D 场景中规划和生成复杂、长视野和细粒度的动作，同时大幅提高生成的未来视频的视觉保真度和几何精度。对合成数据集和真实数据集的大量实验表明，plan4d 在环境反应的生成 4D 建模中实现了最先进的性能。项目页面：https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project
items.authors: Hangwei Zhang, Rujing Dang, Ruimin Lin, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Chuanxia Zheng

items.title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
items.title_zh: 看到不可见的事物：视觉语言模型如何读取、预测和追踪无线电场
items.description: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong, but fail to tell whether a single direct or one-wall path exists. Open models fail even earlier at reading the field itself, and are systematically wrong, scoring below random guessing even when credited for any of four attempts. On unseen cities, fine-tuning brings a 9B open model close to frontier proprietary models on fields, yet neither supervised nor reinforcement fine-tuning improves path tracing. Supervising only final answers teaches models to approximate the field, yet leaves single-path geometry out of reach.
items.description_zh: 在物理世界中进行操作需要超出相机直接捕捉范围的推理。在城市中，无线电信号对镜头来说是不可见的，但它们的强度取决于图像所显示的建筑物和街道。仅考虑到这些可见的结构，视觉语言模型（VLM）能否推断出它们形成的不可见的无线电场？探索真实的物理推理需要真实城市中的精确场域，以及单个物理因素变化的受控干预。我们构建了一个无标签引擎，可以将地球上的任何坐标转变为可光线追踪的城市，模拟匹配的单因素反事实，并准确计算每个答案。这产生了 RadioVISTA，一个用于对不可见场进行视觉推理的基准和训练数据集。从物理上讲，无线电场是其传播路径的总和，但在六大洲，我们发现了一种引人注目的场路径分离：前沿 VLM 准确地判断了场强的位置，但无法判断是否存在单一直接路径或单壁路径。开放模型在解读该领域本身时甚至更早地失败了，而且是系统性错误，即使四次尝试中的任何一次都被认为得分低于随机猜测。在看不见的城市中，微调使 9B 开放模型接近现��的前沿专有模型，但监督和强化微调都无法改善路径追踪。仅监督最终答案可以教会模型近似场，但仍无法实现单路径几何形状。
items.authors: Yiyang Zhu, Xin Li, Guangyuan Liu, Ziheng Liu, Jiayi Zhang, Chau Yuen

items.title: From Points to Trajectories: Rethinking Multimodal Alignment for Physical Events
items.title_zh: 从点到轨迹：重新思考物理事件的多模式对齐
items.description: Advancing physical artificial intelligence (Physical AI) requires moving beyond static object recognition to ground how real-world mechanics (e.g., impact, friction, and force transfer) unfold over time. While multimodal aligners seek to capture these interactions by matching multi-sensor streams, prevailing architectures compress each temporal sequence into a single pooled embedding. We show that this paradigm fails on twin events: distinct physical executions recorded under identical task conditions. Collapsing the temporal dimension averages out transient cross-modal dynamics, effectively reducing physical event alignment to static scene recognition. Formally, we prove that as sequence length increases, any temporally pooled representation converges to the stationary recording condition. Consequently, as windows grow, no choice of loss function or embedding geometry can disambiguate twin events from pooled features alone. Instead, we show that physical events are uniquely identified by the event gap, namely the instantaneous, synchronous co-fluctuations across modalities that are erased by pooling and accumulate only along unpooled trajectories. To recover this signal, we introduce CounterPoint, a lightweight plug-in module that strips out each modality's temporal mean to score frame-level cross-modal agreement. Integrated across four state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal aligners, CounterPoint shifts representations from coarse condition matching to fine-grained physical event alignment, consistently outperforming existing temporal alignment methods.
items.description_zh: 推进物理人工智能（Physical AI）需要超越静态物体识别，以了解现实世界的力学（例如冲击、摩擦和力传递）如何随着时间的推移而展开。虽然多模态对准器试图通过匹配多传感器流来捕获这些交互，但主流架构将每个时间序列压缩为单个池化嵌入。我们表明，这种范例在孪生事件上失败：在相同的任务条件下记录不同的物理执行。压缩时间维度可以平均化瞬态跨模态动态，有效减少物理事件与静态场景识别的对齐。形式上，我们证明随着序列长度的增加，任何时间池表示都会收敛到稳态记录条件。因此，随着窗口的增长，损失函数或嵌入几何形状的选择都无法单独消除孪生事件与池化特征的歧义。相反，我们表明物理事件是由事件间隙唯一标识的，即跨模态的瞬时、同步共同波动，这些波动被池化所消除，并且仅沿着非池化轨迹累积。为了恢复该信号，我们引入了 CounterPoint，这是一个轻量级插件模块，它可以去除每种模态的时间平均值，以对帧级跨模态一致性进行评分。 CounterPoint 集成了四个最先进的 (SOTA) 多模态对准器，将表示从粗略条件匹配转变为细粒度物理事件对准，始终优于现有的时间对准方法。
items.authors: Yiyang Zhu, Guangyuan Liu, Jingdi Lei, Li Wei, Chau Yuen

items.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
items.title_zh: 无反馈自我进化如何重塑智能体技能：系统研究
items.description: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. Putting this knowledge back recovers much of the lost pass rate, so an expert's skill is valuable largely for what the model does not write on its own. Building on this insight, SkillDiff marks this knowledge in place and raises the pass rate on SkillsBench by 4.8 points on average without feedback or any change to the skill's text. Project repository: https://github.com/LitaoGuo/How-Self-Evolution-Reshapes-Skills.
items.description_zh: 代理技能是专家写下程序知识的文档，模型通过在没有反馈的情况下重写它们来不断维护它们。这种重写可以使技能适应使用它的模型，或者侵蚀使其有用的专业知识，但在这种无反馈的自我进化下技能如何进化尚未得到研究。我们让模型在没有任何任务、运行或判断的情况下一轮又一轮地重写专家技能，并使用重写的技能运行在相同模型上构建的代理。我们的实验表明，这些技能不但没有提高，反而失去了价值，因为我们测试的每个模型在每个基准测试中的表现都更差，三十轮后在 SkillsBench 上平均下降了 15 分。通过仅从主题中编写的技能对每个模型的先验进行采样，我们发现重写会将技能拉向该先验，并首先放弃其之外的知识。将这些知识放回去可以恢复大部分丢失的通过率，因此专家的技能在很大程度上对于模型本身没有编写的内容很有价值。基于这一见解，SkillDiff 标记了这些知识，并将 SkillsBench 的通过率平均提高了 4.8 分，而无需反馈或对技能文本进行任何更改。项目存储库：https://github.com/LitaoGuo/How-Self-Evolution-Reshapes-Skills。
items.authors: Litao Guo, Man Chen, Xinli Xu, Jinsong Zhou, Zixin Zhang, Ying-Cong Chen

items.title: Which Dwarf Is This? Doppeldwarf-306 and Near-Identical Instance Retrieval
items.title_zh: 这是哪个矮人？ Doppeldwarf-306 和几乎相同的实例检索
items.description: Most established instance-retrieval benchmarks emphasise landmarks; small sculptures from visually similar series offer a complementary challenge. We introduce Doppeldwarf-306: 1,691 openly licensed photographs of 306 bronze dwarf statues in Wrocław, Poland, many made in themed series that share one style, with the photographer of each image recorded. With no training, nearest-neighbour search over frozen DINOv2 features names the right statue first for 93.1% of leave-one-out queries, and the best of thirteen backbones from seven pretraining paradigms reaches 94.7%. Accuracy falls slowly as candidates are added: for DINOv2, by about 0.8 points each time their number doubles. A natural design for a phone guide compares a photograph only with statues near the user. In simulation this helps, but less than an equal number of randomly chosen statues does, so random subsampling overstates its value; a permutation test ties the penalty to the real layout (p = 0.005). Used as a weight instead of a filter, location raises DINOv2 from 93.4% to 98.7% for a simulated user 25 m from the statue. With the query's photographer withheld, learned local-feature matching raises DINOv2 accuracy from 81.8% to 85.5% and also improves DINOv3. Comparing the two best candidates cuts DINOv2's false acceptance of unknown statues from 38.3% to 19.6% at 90% known acceptance.
items.description_zh: 大多数已建立的实例检索基准都强调地标；视觉上相似系列的小型雕塑提供了互补的挑战。我们介绍 Doppeldwarf-306：1,691 张公开许可的照片，拍摄了波兰弗罗茨瓦夫的 306 座青铜矮人雕像，其中许多是在主题系列中拍摄的，具有相同的风格，并记录了每张图像的摄影师。在没有训练的情况下，对冻结 DINOv2 特征的最近邻搜索在 93.1% 的留一查询中首先命名正确的雕像，并且来自 7 个预训练范例的 13 个主干中最好的达到 94.7%。随着候选者的增加，准确度会缓慢下降：对于 DINOv2，每次数量增加一倍，准确率就会下降约 0.8 个点。电话指南的自然设计仅将照片与用户附近的雕像进行比较。在模拟中这会有所帮助，但少于相同数量的随机选择的雕像所起的作用，因此随机二次采样夸大了其价值；排列测试将惩罚与实际布局联系起来 (p = 0.005)。对于距离雕像 25 m 的模拟用户，位置用作权重而不是过滤器，将 DINOv2 从 93.4% 提高到 98.7%。在保留查询的摄影师的情况下，学习的局部特征匹配�� DINOv2 的准确率从 81.8% 提高到 85.5%，并且还提高了 DINOv3。比较两个最佳候选者，将 DINOv2 对未知雕像的错误接受率从 38.3% 降低到 19.6%，已知接受率达到 90%。

items.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.title_zh: 通过策略自蒸馏从未标记视频中学习视频预见推理
items.description: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at https://jingchensun.github.io/future-opsd/
items.description_zh: 视频预见推理需要视觉语言模型来预测当前观察到的视频中的未来事件或下一步行动。现有的方法适合未来的标题、基本原理或完整的视觉状态，但面临两个限制。首先，它们依赖注释或外部大型模型进行监督，限制了可扩展性。我们通过策略自蒸馏框架来解决这个问题，该框架将过去未来的视频对转换为自然的自我监督信号，无需额外的注释或LLM监督。其次，他们将整个未来剪辑视为同样有价值，尽管其中大部分是不相关的上下文信息。我们通过定义预见分数来解决这个问题，从中我们获得对比特权优势，驱动模型学习最有价值的未来信息。由于分数是棘手的，我们优化了一个易于处理的下限代理，该代理插入了这个优势，在真实和随机参考未来之间计算，并具有师生蒸馏优势；它们共同放大了与决策相关的内容信息并抑制了不相关的上下文信息。我们将由此产生的框架称为 Future-OPSD。在开放式预测和封闭式规划方面，Future-OPSD 将基础模型分别提高了 14.2 和 15.9 个点，且不影响一般视频理解。代码可在 https://jingchensun.github.io/future-opsd/ 获取
items.authors: Jingchen Sun, Jiaxing Zhang, Qingqiao Hu, Dingqiang Ye, Yuqi Jia, Yijun Liang, Di Fu, Yunjie Tian, Dongdi Zhao, Changyou Chen

items.title: Autoregressive View Model
items.description: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.
items.description_zh: 我们提出了自回归视图模型 (AVM)，它可以将场景生成为视图流，而无需构建显式 3D 表示。通过统一的上下文界面，AVM 以图像或视频为条件，沿着请求的摄像机路径生成短片。视觉上下文为重建和插值奠定了基础，而学习的先验可以外推到看不见的区域。 AVM 从输入和生成的历史记录中检索相关视图，以形成有界活动上下文。我们通过 N-in-1-out 公式中的流匹配来微调预训练的双向视频扩散变压器。然后，我们在其自身的推出中调整因果模型，以提高真实感、减少去噪步骤并限制长范围漂移。我们将训练规模扩大到大约 800 万个场景和视频剪辑。我们跨相机控制、文本控制、视觉质量、动态、稀疏和 4D 重建以及长视野一致性的基准评估生成能力和场景持久性。结果表明，AVM 通过一个上下文界面适应不同的输入和输出设置。
items.authors: Jensen, Zhou, Samuel Rota Bulo, Denis Rozumny, Duncan Zauss, Peter Hedman, Nikhil Keetha, Philip Torr, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi, Peter Kontschieder

items.title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
items.title_zh: 从头开始搜索：语言模型的搜索本机预训练
items.description: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.
items.description_zh: 现代语言模型 (LM) 越来越多地部署，可以在推理时访问搜索工具。然而，预训练仍然主要集中于预测静态文本，通常在训练后引入搜索功能。我们提出搜索原生预训练作为在普通文本语料库预训练期间教授搜索能力的实用途径。具体来说，我们通过网络搜索查询大规模扩展预训练语料库，并使用本地索引检索网络响应。对这个增强语料库的训练教会模型生成搜索调用并在语言建模过程中合并检索到的证据。在 Wikipedia 和 DCLM-Edu 语料库以及 360M 至 3.3B 参数范围内，搜索预训练模型（“QueryLM”）在知识密集型任务上表现出改进的性能，并且对检索到的证据具有更高的可操纵性。至关重要的是，在对搜索预训练模型和传统预训练模型进行监督微调后，它们的优势仍然存在，这表明测试后的训练程序并不能完全恢复预训练期间开发的功能。在我们的实验中，我们发现 1.4B QueryLM 在所有知识密集型任务中始终优于或匹配 FLOP 匹配的 3.3B 基线模型的性能。这些结果将搜索预训练确立为在预训练期间开发基础搜索能力的实用方法。我们发布训练工件，包括模型检查点和数据。
items.authors: Kaustubh Ponkshe, Gyung Hyun Je, Stefan Taga, Colin Raffel, Martin Jaggi

items.title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
items.title_zh: 分解和组合：通过物理变化跟踪对象
items.description: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. Prior work addresses only disassemblies, relying on expensive searches triggered only when tracking fails. We propose Tracking Instances via Proposals and Overlaps (TIPO), a training-free framework that continuously infers transformations via a generate-evaluate-judge pipeline. TIPO generates split and merge proposals from disjoint mask components, scores them against mask-decoder priors using inner and external overlap, and queries an MLLM on the top proposal for visual verification and semantic labeling. To benchmark TTU, we curate Video Instances, States, and Transformation Annotations (VISTA), a dataset including state graphs with 124 assembly and 132 disassembly events across 50 sequences and over 26,000 frames. TIPO achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy on VISTA, while operating 6times to 15times faster than prior methods. Project page: https://davidegardenal.github.io/tipo-tracking
items.description_zh: 我们引入了变换跟踪和理解 (TTU)，将视频对象跟踪扩展到对象进行物理组装和拆卸的环境。 TTU 需要通过转换持续跟踪对象、识别新实体、维护其关系的状态图以及为转换分配语义标签。虽然基础模型（例如 SAM 2/3）通过外观变化维护轨迹，但它们无法随着对象物理演化而更新语义标识。先前的工作仅解决反汇编问题，依赖于仅在跟踪失败时触发的昂贵搜索。我们提出通过提案和重叠跟踪实例（TIPO），这是一个无需��训的框架，可以通过生成-评估-判断管道不断推断转换。 TIPO 从不相交的掩模组件中生成拆分和合并提案，使用内部和外部重叠根据掩模解码器先验对它们进行评分，并在顶部提案上查询 MLLM 以进行视觉验证和语义标记。为了对 TTU 进行基准测试，我们策划了视频实例、状态和转换注释 (VISTA)，这是一个包含状态图的数据集，其中包含 50 个序列和 26,000 多个帧中的 124 个组装事件和 132 个反汇编事件。 TIPO 在 VISTA 上实现了最先进的跟踪和状态图精度，同时运行速度比以前的方法快 6 倍到 15 倍。项目页面：https://davidegardenal.github.io/tipo-tracking
items.authors: Davide Gardenal, Mingxuan Liu, Flavio Vella, Quentin Guimard, Elisa Ricci
